name: sugar_nebula
theme: a neon candy stall at night dives through a lollipop's sugar crystals into a candy-colored quasar, then falls back down a taffy sky into the carnival street it came from

registers.name: candy_stall
registers.palette: neon magenta and deep night blue
registers.scene: a neon candy stall on a dark cobbled lane at night, seen from across the lane at street level, its striped awning and counter outlined in magenta and cyan tubing, shelves of candy jars and racks of wrapped sweets behind the counter, a hand-painted sign above, empty, no one present
registers.target: a large spiral lollipop, a flat disc of glossy candy coiled in magenta, cyan and white bands
registers.loop_target: a neon candy stall on a dark cobbled lane at night, striped awning and counter outlined in magenta and cyan tubing

registers.name: lollipop
registers.scene: a giant spiral lollipop standing on the stall counter, a flat disc of hard glossy candy coiled in wide bands of magenta, cyan and white, its surface bright and faintly ridged, neon tubing and racks of wrapped sweets behind it
registers.target: a crust of coarse sugar crystals, faceted yellow and clear grains

registers.name: rock_candy_spires
registers.palette: bright yellow, white and pale gold
registers.scene: a forest of rock-candy spires, towering faceted sugar columns in bright yellow, white and pink, jagged crystal ground between them, magenta and cyan light in the facets
registers.target: a lattice of clear sugar-glass shards, thin angular plates fused edge to edge

registers.name: sugar_lattice
registers.palette: clear violet and cyan on black
registers.scene: a lattice of clear sugar-glass shards spread through the black, thin angular plates fused edge to edge into an open honeycomb foam, the foam repeating away in every direction, violet and cyan light along every edge

registers.name: quasar_disk
registers.scene: a colossal quasar accretion disk across all of space, glossy bands of magenta, cyan and white wound flat around a brilliant white core, a narrow straight jet of white light above the center, black space beyond the rim
registers.target: a bank of pink cotton-candy nebula, a dense spun floss cloud threaded with cyan

registers.name: candyfloss_nebula
registers.scene: vast banks of cotton-candy nebula in the black, spun pink and white floss piled in soft towers, cyan light threading the folds
registers.target: a banded gumball planet, a round sphere striped in glossy orange, pink and white

registers.name: gumball_planet
registers.scene: an enormous gumball planet hanging in the black, a hard candy shell banded in orange, pink, white and cyan around its curve, black space at its limb
registers.target: a clear gap in the striped cloud deck

registers.name: taffy_clouds
registers.palette: pink and white on deep night blue
registers.scene: a night sky of pulled-taffy clouds, thick glossy ribbons of pink, white and pale yellow banked on either side, deep blue-black air in the channel between them
registers.target: a lit carnival street, striped stalls and strung bulbs

registers.name: carnival_street
registers.palette: neon magenta and warm bulb gold
registers.scene: a night carnival street seen from just above the lane, rows of striped stalls under long strings of glowing bulbs, painted ride towers and a lit ticket booth along the wet cobbles, a neon candy stall glowing at the corner of the lane, empty, no one present

music_theme: bright kitsch synth-pop shimmer, glassy bells and fat neon bass, playful and sugary, a huge magenta swell landing on the sugar-lattice-to-quasar morph and a soft floss-light drift through the nebula
